verdict.rationale: Kino ships its own editing agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only shows the opposite role: Kino's desktop app runs an MCP server that external agents (ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) connect to. That is server-side and does not count toward this client story. Nothing shows Kino's agent connecting to or using third-party MCP servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
